generation_rule: Generate the literal product of carrier, atom-support, adjacency, encoding-number, fibre-relation, identity, process and extension alternatives; decide all 256 forms from admitted form enforcement, exact graph, distinction, conservation, molecular identity, bond-order, electronic-state and conjugated-support dependencies.
grammar_boundary: Every finite complete connected alternating molecular representation pair related by global Fold-fibre complement. Larger finite representation classes are generated by composition of exact local pair relations while retaining the same carrier, atoms and adjacency. The empirical boundary is the four complete preregistered IUPAC records.
